newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC sees 96/97 PC sales rising to 975 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: NEC sees 96/97 PC sales rising to 975 bln yen.

text.p: NEC Corp said on Thursday it expects sales of personal computers and related products in domestic and overseas markets to total 975 billion yen in the year to March 31.
Japan's top personal computer maker expects sales to rise another 20 percent next business year.

"Parent sales at our PC division this business year are expected to be 975 billion yen, and if the market rises 20 percent in 1997/98, our sales will also rise by 20 percent and exceed one trillion yen," a company spokesman said.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun business daily reported on Thursday that Toshiba Corp, an NEC rival in the computer market, would see PC sales rise to 730 billion yen in 1996/97, up 82 percent from the previous year.
It added that Toshiba's PC sales would reach one trillion yen in 1997/98, boosted by strong sales of its notebook PCs.
Toshiba officials could not immediately confirm the report.
